He made me feel very comfortable throughout the process, successfully treated the issue, and also guided me well for the next phase of my journey. Truly grateful for his care and expertise

featured_reviews.name: Priyank Tibrewal
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr Ankesh has been more than a gynaec, he has been an angel to me throughout. His humble and sensitive nature will put you at ease. I truly recommend him. The process was very smooth, comforting, easy and he was empathetic. A big Thankyou to you Doc

featured_reviews.name: Sanchari Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr. Ankesh has been like absolute family to me and my husband over the years, wherein he has treated me for PCOD and fibroids, through my first conception, C Section and now for routine checkups. He has seen all the ups and downs in my life over a period of 7 years. He is someone who treats his patients with care and utmost support, even in the wee hours of when someone would not be approachable usually. His father is also a pillar of strength and a smiling face whenever we visit the hospital. Thank you for being a part of my journey, doctors.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Puri

Doctors like him, who combine expertise with genuine care and availability, are truly rare to find.
